items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: His regular clarinet player just came to me now. His name was Zeb.

ctx.x: Remember who his clarinet player was?

Who, a buddy? No, kid Rene. No, Rene? Well, sometime Rene would have... This fellow. Sometime he'd have Burbank. When he couldn't get Burbank, sometime he'd have a Georgia boy. And his regular clarinet player just came to me now. His name was Zeb.
Oh, Zeb. That's what I've heard of him. I never did know him.
